selection_policy: Train: all 250 LAB tasks under tasks/firm-knowledge/ (sorted by task id), which share the firm-knowledge/dms document store through docs_dir; no eligibility filter (apply_task_filter: false). Validation and test each hold one placeholder, the first validation and first test task of splits-v2.json, because AHE requires non-empty splits; campaign 9 evaluates only C0 on train, so they are never run. Built by scripts/make_splits_firm_knowledge.py. Pins are sha256 of task.json and of the document tree hash map (the shared store for firm-knowledge tasks).
